contains: mutation_failed "$n" "  the $label copy did not bu

skips.regex: \ \ no\ openssl\ and\ python\ here\ \(or\ Windows,\ whose\ s_server\ this\ gate\ does\ not\ drive\),\ so\ OpenSSL\ goes\ unasked
skips.text: echo "  no openssl and python here (or Windows, whose s_server this gate does not drive), so OpenSSL goes unasked"

skips.regex: \ \ .*?\ has\ no\ X25519MLKEM768\ \(OpenSSL\ has\ it\ from\ 3\.5\),\ so\ the\ client's\ hybrid\ goes\ unasked\ by\ it
skips.text: echo "  $("$OPENSSL" version) has no X25519MLKEM768 (OpenSSL has it from 3.5), so the client's hybrid goes unasked by it"

skips.regex: \ \ no\ openssl\ and\ python\ here,\ so\ TLS\ 1\.2\ goes\ unasked
skips.text: echo "  no openssl and python here, so TLS 1.2 goes unasked"

skips.regex: \ \ a\ server\ without\ the\ extended\ master\ secret:\ this\ OpenSSL\ \(.*?\)\ cannot\ serve\ one,\ so\ it\ goes\ unasked
skips.text: echo "  a server without the extended master secret: this OpenSSL ($("$OPENSSL" version | cut -d' ' -f2)) cannot serve one, so it goes unasked"

skips.regex: \ \ no\ python\ cryptography\ here,\ so\ the\ server\ goes\ unasked
skips.text: echo "  no python cryptography here, so the server goes unasked"

skips.regex: \ \ OpenSSL,\ .*?:\ no\ X25519MLKEM768\ in\ this\ OpenSSL\ \(it\ has\ it\ from\ 3\.5\),\ so\ the\ server's\ hybrid\ goes\ unasked\ by\ s_client
skips.text: echo "  OpenSSL, $kind: no X25519MLKEM768 in this OpenSSL (it has it from 3.5), so the server's hybrid goes unasked by s_client"

skips.regex: \ \ no\ openssl\ here\ \(or\ Windows\),\ so\ s_client\ goes\ unasked
skips.text: echo "  no openssl here (or Windows), so s_client goes unasked"

skips.regex: \ \ OpenSSL,\ TLS\ 1\.2,\ .*?,\ no\ extended\ master\ secret:\ this\ OpenSSL\ \(.*?\)\ cannot\ leave\ it\ out,\ so\ it\ goes\ unasked
skips.text: echo "  OpenSSL, TLS 1.2, $kind, no extended master secret: this OpenSSL ($("$OPENSSL" version | cut -d' ' -f2)) cannot leave it out, so it goes unasked"

skips.regex: \ \ no\ python\ cryptography\ here,\ so\ the\ TLS\ 1\.2\ server\ goes\ unasked
skips.text: echo "  no python cryptography here, so the TLS 1.2 server goes unasked"

skips.regex: \ \ no\ OpenSSL\ with\ s_server\ \-status_file,\ or\ no\ python\ cryptography\ with\ x509\.ocsp,\ here\ \(or\ Windows\),\ so\ stapling\ goes\ unasked
skips.text: echo "  no OpenSSL with s_server -status_file, or no python cryptography with x509.ocsp, here (or Windows), so stapling goes unasked"

skips.regex: \ \ no\ Go\ 1\.25\ or\ later\ here,\ so\ Go's\ ECH\ client\ and\ server\ go\ unasked
skips.text: echo "  no Go 1.25 or later here, so Go's ECH client and server go unasked"

skips.regex: \ \ no\ scripted\ server\ to\ refuse\ a\ handshake,\ so\ the\ sentence\ goes\ unshown
skips.text: echo "  no scripted server to refuse a handshake, so the sentence goes unshown"

skips.regex: \ \ no\ copy\ of\ the\ client\ offering\ TLS\ 1\.2\ alone\ here,\ so\ the\ sentinel's\ proof\ before\ it\ is\ unmeasured
skips.text: echo "  no copy of the client offering TLS 1.2 alone here, so the sentinel's proof before it is unmeasured"

skips.regex: \ \ no\ openssl\ here\ \(or\ Windows\),\ so\ the\ server's\ TLS\ 1\.2\ exporter\ proof\ is\ unmeasured
skips.text: echo "  no openssl here (or Windows), so the server's TLS 1.2 exporter proof is unmeasured"

pass_sentinel.text: echo "the std/tls exercise holds ($mutations breaks caught)"
